What is Kai Resolve?

Kai Resolve is the AI support engineer for second-level (tier 2) support in Gleap. Kai Support answers customers as the first level; Kai Resolve investigates the tickets Kai Support cannot answer using the screen recording, logs and click trail captured by the Gleap SDK, account data from connected sources and your code. It answers the customer when the evidence settles the ticket, prepares a coding task for confirmed bugs and escalates open questions to your team with a diagnosis: its classification of the ticket and the evidence behind it.

About Gleap

> Gleap is AI-native customer support for software teams, support that ships fixes: agents that work inside the customer conversation, the code and the roadmap, with the company's own team in control. Its agents, Kai Support, Kai Resolve, Kai PM and Kai Code, answer customer questions, investigate bugs with screen recordings, logs and code, prioritize feature requests and open pull requests, while the customer's own team reviews and ships. More than 4,500 teams use Gleap, including Squarespace, UNICEF and Papa Johns. Gleap GmbH is based in Schwarzach, Austria.
